Class RoomService

java.lang.Object
at.qe.skeleton.services.RoomService
@Service public class RoomService extends Object
Service responsible for managing rooms and their relationships to departments, buildings, employees, and IoT devices.

This service enforces key business rules such as:

  • Rooms are soft-deleted (marked inactive instead of removed)
  • Rooms may have at most one Raspberry Pi
  • Device decommissioning is triggered on deletion
  • Employee assignment constraints are validated before deletion

    • delete

      @PreAuthorize("hasAuthority('SYSTEM_ADMIN')") @Transactional public void delete(Long id)
      Soft deletes a room.

      Business rules:

      • Room must have no assigned employees
      • Sensor stations are decommissioned
      • Raspberry Pi is decommissioned if present
      • Room is detached from department and building
      • Room is marked inactive instead of physically deleted
